182:     def create_suspended(self, protection, permit, startup):
183:         port, p = self.port, self.f.primitives
184:         record = port.lifecycle._records[port.key]
185:         assert type(startup) is flow.adapter._OwnedASRStart
186:         assert startup.policy is port.adapter_profile and startup.binding is port.generated_binding
187:         assert startup.usage == "reliability" and permit is record.permit
188:         assert record.protection is protection and record.phase is Phase.NATIVE_RESERVED
189:         assert type(record.owner) is OwnedSession and record.owner._manager is port.lifecycle
190:         assert port.binding_calls == 1 and port.adapter_startup is None
191:         port.adapter_startup, port.permit, port._start_attempted = startup, permit, True
192:         port.authority_events.append("inert_start_after_actual_adapter_binding")
193:         self.owner, self.record = record.owner, record
194:         self.token = port.lifecycle._token(port.key)
195:         self.setup.before_process("CreateProcessW")
196:         process, thread, job = [p._retain(9000 + i, name)
197:             for i, name in enumerate(("process", "thread", "job"))]
198:         worker = WorkerRecord(process=process, thread=thread, job=job,
199:             read_set=protection, creation_time=self.creation_time, assigned=True,
200:             creation_info=SimpleNamespace(pid=123))
201:         port.worker = worker
202:         p.workers.append(worker)
203:         protection.worker_reserved = True
204:         pair = PipePair(server=p._retain(9010, "pipe-server"),
205:             client=p._retain(9011, "pipe-client"), worker=worker, read_set=protection)
206:         port.pair = pair
207:         self.pipes.pairs.append(pair)
208:         # Simulates confirmed parent-side retirement of the inherited endpoint.
209:         p._close(pair.client)
210:         # The fixed native boundary contains five read duplicates plus control.
211:         # These are inert retained owners, not an observation of inheritance.
212:         worker.inherited_copies = [p._retain(9020 + i, "inert-inherited-copy") for i in range(6)]
213:         for duplicate in worker.inherited_copies:
214:             p._close(duplicate)
215:         port.channel = InertChannel(self)
216:         port.handshake = InertHandshake(self)

235:     def write_frame(self, pair, frame, expires):
236:         assert pair is self.port.pair and expires == 11.0
237:         with self.pipes._frame_operation(pair):
238:             assert self.owner._active == 1 and not self.owner._revoked
239:             operation, payload = frame
240:             if operation == "begin":
241:                 assert payload == {"manifest_sha256": self.port.manifest}
242:                 self.events.append("inert_begin")
243:                 return
244:             assert operation == "next"
245:             action = payload["action"]
246:             self.transport_actions.append(action)
247:             op = flow.operation_flow
248:             if action == "admit_generated_media":
249:                 assert payload == {"action": action, "media_id": op.MEDIA_ID}
250:                 response = "done", op.contract_payload(self.port.channel.binding)
251:             elif action == "begin_generated_transcription":
252:                 assert payload["media_id"] == op.MEDIA_ID
253:                 assert payload["options"] == op.fixed_options(self.request)
254:                 response = "done", {"cursor_id": op.CURSOR_ID, "started": True, "produced_segments": 0}
255:             elif action == "next_generated_segment":
256:                 index = payload["index"]
257:                 assert payload == {"action": action, "cursor_id": op.CURSOR_ID, "index": index}
258:                 assert index in (0, 1)
259:                 response = "segment", {"cursor_id": op.CURSOR_ID, "index": index, "segment": op.SEGMENTS[index]}
260:             else:
261:                 raise AssertionError("unexpected extra wire request: " + action)
262:             self.pending_frames.append(response)
